title: EKS eviction audit
description: Eviction-API calls and pod deletions from the EKS control plane audit log in CloudWatch. 201 = evicted, 429 = refused by a PodDisruptionBudget.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, user.username, objectRef.namespace, objectRef.name, responseStatus.code
| filter objectRef.resource = "pods" and objectRef.subresource = "eviction" and verb = "create"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

panels.title: Pod deletions by users and controllers (excluding the kubelet)

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, user.username, objectRef.namespace, objectRef.name, responseStatus.code
| filter objectRef.resource = "pods" and verb = "delete" and ispresent(objectRef.name) and user.username not like /^system:node:/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
